LanguageData.CHF_PackCommandDesc: Walk up to a colonist, slave, animal or mech with rechargeable implants and recharge them from this pack. The target stops while the pack works.\n\nDelivers up to {0} charge per use over {1} seconds. A use is spent only when the recharge completes.
LanguageData.CHF_PackInvalid_NotWorn: the pack is not being worn
LanguageData.CHF_PackInvalid_WrongMap: target is on a different map
LanguageData.CHF_PackInvalid_NotColonyOwned: not a colony pawn, slave, animal or mech
LanguageData.CHF_PackInvalid_MentalState: target is in a mental state
LanguageData.CHF_PackInvalid_NotInterruptible: target cannot be interrupted right now
LanguageData.CHF_PackInvalid_Reserved: target is busy with someone else
LanguageData.CHF_Stat_PackChargePerUse_Desc: The most implant charge one completed recharge adds to the target, summed across all of its implants. Each completed recharge spends one {CHARGENOUN}.
LanguageData.CHF_Stat_PackDuration_Desc: How long the wearer must stand next to the target for one recharge to complete.
